reading: Out of distribution the model is at the random floor overall (25.3 vs 25.0 random for the five accuracy domains). This is consistent with, and stronger evidence for, the model card's existing finding that it predicts UltraFeedback-style preferences and does not transfer. The official 435M OpenAssistant DeBERTa scores 32.0 on the same benchmark; encoder-class reward models as a category sit near the floor here, versus 61-84 for modern decoder classifiers. Bright spot: Math 47.1 vs OA's 50.3 at 40% of the parameters.
